summary: Join Nasdaq Technology in Bangalore to develop front-end modernization and performance optimization solutions for our financial services web platform, focusing on LitElement and modern JavaScript standards.
responsibilities: Develop and optimize front-end components using LitElement and modern JavaScript standards.
Contribute to Progressive Web Application (PWA) development for the platform.
Implement responsive design and accessibility features across tools.
Collaborate with backend developers to integrate with PHP-based APIs and Java microservices.
Participate in dependency version upgrades and modernization initiatives.
Assist in preparing the platform for app store deployment.
Work closely with QA, infrastructure, and data teams to ensure performance and reliability.
required_skills: LitElement (or similar frameworks like React, Vue, Angular)
nice_to_have_skills: Progressive Web Applications (PWA) and mobile optimization
Performance profiling and front-end observability tools
benefits: Join the Nasdaq Dorsey Wright Platform Extensions team
Work closely with colleagues in Bangalore and teams in other countries
